name: Silent Tide: Multi-Stage Cloud-Enabled Intrusion
description:
Background

A sophisticated adversary conducts extensive reconnaissance, builds infrastructure, and gains foothold via a spearphishing attachment. Subsequent stealthy credential theft, data collection, and proxy-based C2 lead to staged exfiltration before impact.

Your Task

As a SOC analyst, triage the alerts in the scenario file. Identify which alerts are true positives and which are false positives. Piece together the attack story by correlating the MITRE ATT&CK techniques across the kill chain.
